title: Repo Local Guidance
description: Canonical specialist for thin-root AGENTS guidance with longer support docs under .agents, tracked on the operator's GitHub; company clones use excluded symlinks to a GitHub companion repo.
scope_boundary: In scope: thin root AGENTS guidance, .agents support docs, where they are versioned (operator GitHub repo or GitHub companion repo for a company clone). Out of scope: any exclusion not confirmed by the operator.

stable_facts.statement: Root AGENTS.md stays at repo root because Codex auto-loads repo guidance from AGENTS.md, not from .agents/.
.agents/ is the place for longer repo support docs when root AGENTS.md should stay thin.
Governance files are tracked on the operator's GitHub; a company clone holds symlinks to the real files in the GitHub companion repo, listed in its .git/info/exclude.
